extracted.name: Chocolate Cavity-Maker Cake
extracted.description: This chocolate cavity-maker cake is made with three chocolate favorites: cake mix, pudding mix, and chocolate chips. Enjoy, but don’t tell your dentist!
ingredient_lines: 1 (18.25 ounce) package dark chocolate cake mix
1 (3.9 ounce) package instant chocolate pudding mix
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 10-inch Bundt pan.
In a large bowl, beat cake mix, pudding mix, sour cream, eggs, oil, and coffee liqueur until well blended. Fold in chocolate chips. Batter will be thick. Spoon into the prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until cake springs back when lightly tapped, about 1 hour. Cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a wire rack and let cool completely.
